# FLA-derived normalization kernel

`../../qk_repeat_l2norm_kernel.py` is derived from the FLA L2Norm forward kernel and retains its original copyright notice. Its header's reference to the source-tree root `LICENSE` refers to the upstream FLA source tree, not the VeOmni repository root (which uses Apache 2.0). The applicable FLA MIT license is reproduced in this directory's `LICENSE`.

The experimental kernel is kept byte-for-byte identical to the qualified recording so its qualification SHA remains valid. This accompanying notice clarifies the retained header without changing the frozen kernel.

Upstream project: https://github.com/fla-org/flash-linear-attention

License source snapshot (2026-10-10): `7b5138a92133132cfc5f80455c9c0920d4fe0278`. This is the license retrieval snapshot, not a claim that the installed historical FLA wheel was built from this commit.
